itemDisplayName: Connect a Foundry project to Foundry models with project managed identity
description: Creates an ApiManagement-category connection directly to an existing Foundry account and optionally grants the source project's managed identity Foundry User on that account. A prompt agent invokes an existing model deployment as connection/deployment through the Responses API. No API Management service or model deployment is created.
summary: Keyless project-to-Foundry model connection with project-managed-identity authentication and target-account RBAC.
